senses.gloss: प्र-ध॑न n. (cf. ध॑न) spoil taken in battle, a prize gained by a victor, the battle or contest itself, RV. &c. &c.
the best of one's goods, valuables, Nār.
tearing, bursting &c. (= दारण), L.
प्र-ध॑न m. N. of a man
प्र-ध॑न m. pl. his descendants, BrahmaP.
प्रधान n. a chief thing or person, the most important or essential part of anything, KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ibc.) the principal or first, chief, head of

[often also ifc. (f(आ). ) e.g. इन्द्र-प्रधान, (a hymn) having Indra as the chief object or person addressed, Nir.; प्रयोग-प्˚, (the art of dancing) having practice as its essential part, chiefly practical, Mālav.]
‘the Originator’, primary germ, original source of the visible or material universe (in Sāṃkhya = प्रकृति, q.v.), IW. 53, 1 &c.
primary or unevolved matter or nature, Sarvad.
supreme or universal soul, L.
intellect, understanding, L.
the first companion or attendant of a king, a courtier, a noble (also m.), L.
an elephant-driver (also m.), L.
(in gram.) the principal member of a compound (opp. to उपसर्जन, q.v.)
प्रधान mf(आ)n. chief, main, principal, most important
pre-eminent in (instr.)
better than or superior to (abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
प्रधान m. N. of an ancient king, MBh.
प्रधाना f. N. of a Śakti, Tantr. (cf. IW. 522).
प्रधनाघातक mfn. bringing about a contest, Hcar.
प्रधनाङ्गण n. a battle-field, Vcar.
प्रधनोत्तम n. ‘best of battles’, a great battle or contest, MW.
प्रधानोत्तम mfn. best of the eminent, illustrious
warlike, brave, W.
प्रधन्य᳙ mf(आ)n. forming the spoil or booty (as cattle), RV.
प्रधान्य w.r. for प्राध्˚, q.v., MBh.
प्रा—धान्य n. predominance, prevalence, ascendency, supremacy, KātyŚr.; Śaṃk.; Suśr. &c.
ibc. in regard to the highest object or chief matter, chiefly, mainly, summarily, Nir.; MBh.; Hariv. &c. (-स्तुति mfn. chiefly praised)
प्रा—धान्य m. a chief or most distinguished person, Vet.
प्र-धमन See प्र-√ ध्मा.
प्र-˚धमन n. blowing into (the nose, as powder)
a sternutatory, Suśr.
प्र-धर्ष &c. See प्र-√ धृष्.
प्र-˚धर्ष m. attacking, assaulting, assailing (see दुष्-प्˚).
प्र-धा f., ib. vi, 4, 64, Sch.
N. of a daughter of Dakṣa, MBh.; MārkP. (prob. w.r. for प्राधा).
प्र-√ 2. धा See प्र-√ धे, col. 2
प्र-ध m., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 139, Sch.
प्रा—धा f. (cf. प्र-धा) N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and mother of sev. Apsaras and Gandharvas, MBh.; Hariv.
प्राधा प्राधानिक &c. See under 3. प्रा, p. 702.

प्रधान—कर्मन् or प्रधान—कार्य, n. chief or principal action;
 principal mode of treatment (in med.), Suśr.; Madhus.

प्रधान—कर्मन् or प्रधान—कार्य, n. chief or principal action;
 principal mode of treatment (in med.), Suśr.; Madhus.
प्रधान—कारण-वाद m. the doctrine that Pradhāna is the original cause (according to the Sāṃkhya), Bādar., Sch.
प्रधान—तम mfn. most excellent or distinguished, most important, chiefest, MBh.; Suśr.
प्रधान—तर mfn. more excellent, better, MārkP.
प्रधान—तस् ind. according to eminence or superiority, Mn.; MBh.; Hariv.
प्रधान—ता f. pre-eminence, excellence, superiority, prevalence, R.; Hariv.; Hit.; Vedāntas.
the being Pradhāna q.v.
(in MBh. iii, 173 = जगत्-कारणता; cf. शरीर-प्˚).
प्रधान—त्व n. pre-eminence, superiority, excellence, ĀśvŚr.; MBh.
(in Sāṃkhya) the being Pradhāna, Sāṃkhyak., Sch.
प्रधान—धातु m. ‘chief element of the body’, semen virile, L.
प्रधान—पुरुष m. a chief person, most distinguished personage, an authority, Mn.; Mālav.
‘the supreme soul’, N. of Śiva, MBh.
प्रधान—पुरु˚षातीत m. transcending Pradhāna and Puruṣa (matter and spirit)
N. of Śiva, MW.
प्रधान—भाज् mfn. ‘receiving the chief share’, most excellent or distinguished, MBh.
प्रधान—भूत mfn. one who is the chief person, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 4, 54.
प्रधान—मन्त्रिन् m. a prime minister, R.; Hit.; Vet.
प्रधान—मित्र n. a chief friend, R.
प्रधान—वादिन् m. one who asserts the Sāṃkhya doctrine (of Pradhāna), Bādar., Sch.
प्रधान—वासस् n. the best clothes, full-dress, Mṛcch.
प्रधान—वृष्टि f. copious rain, heaviest rain, Var.
प्रधान—शिष्ट mfn. taught or laid down as of primary importance, MW. (cf. अन्वाचय-श्˚).
प्रधान—सभिक m. the chief of a gambling-house, Mṛcch.
प्रधान—सेवा f. chief or principal service, Pañcat.
प्रधानाङ्ग n. a chief member, the ch˚ m˚ of the body
most eminent person in a state
principal branch of a science &c., W.
प्रधानात्मन् m. supreme or universal soul, N. of Viṣṇu, VP.
(identified with the original cause of the universe or Viśva-bhāvana, W.)
प्रधानाध्यक्ष m. a chief superintendent
प्रधानाध्यक्ष—ता f. the office of ch˚ s˚, Kathās.
प्रधानामात्य m. a prime minister, W.
प्र-धानाहुति f. a chief oblation, ĀpGṛ.
प्रधानक n. (in Sāṃkhya) the original germ out of which the material universe is evolved (= प्रधान, अ-व्यक्त, q.v.), Tattvas.
प्र-धि॑ m. the felly of a wheel (also pl.), RV. &c. &c.
orb, disc (of the moon), RV. x, 138, 6
a segment, Śulbas.
प्र-धि See above.

1. प्र-√ धी (or -दीधी, only p. pr. -दीध्यत् and -दी॑ध्यान), to long for, strive after, RV. i, 113, 10;
to look out, be on the watch, AV. x, 4, 11.
2. प्र-धी f. great intelligence, Vop.
प्र-धी mfn. of superior i˚, pre-eminently intelligent, ib.
प्राधी (प्र-अधि-√ इ) P. Ā. प्राध्येति, ˚धीते, to continue to study, advance in studies, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
प्र-धि—मण्डल n. the circumference of (the felly of) a wheel, MW.
प्र-˚ध्य्-अनीक n. the centre of a segment, Śulbas.
a well, L.

प्र-√ 2. धाव् P. Ā. -धावति, ˚ते, to wash or rub off, ŚBr. :
Caus. P. Ā. -धावयति, ˚ते, to wash or cause to w˚ off, MBh.
1. प्र-˚धावन m. a runner, L.
2. प्र-˚धावन m. air, wind, L. (regarded as a ‘purifier’, cf. पवन; or perhaps fr. √ 1. धाव्, reg˚ as a ‘runner’)
प्र-˚धावन n. rubbing or washing off, Suśr.; Gaut.
प्र-˚धावित mfn. run away, set out, started, MBh.; R.; Pañcat. &c.
प्र-धुर n. the tip of a pole, ĀpŚr.
प्र-धूपित mfn. fumigated, perfumed, MBh.
heated, burnt
lighted, inflamed
afflicted
excited, W.
प्र-धूपिता f. (with or scil. दिश्) the quarter to which the sun is proceeding, L.
a woman in trouble or affliction, ib.
प्र-धूमित mfn. smothered with smoke, giving out smoke, smouldering, Ragh.
प्र-˚धारण mfn. keeping, preserving, protecting (see पाद-प्र्˚)
प्र-˚धारणा f. constantly fixing one's mind on a certain object, MBh.
प्र-धार्य mfn. to be regarded as (nom.), Bcar.
प्र-˚धर्षक mfn. (ifc.), molesting, hurting, violating (the wife of another), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
प्र-˚धर्षण mfn. (ifc.) attacking, molesting, harassing, MBh.
प्र-˚धर्षण nf. attacking, assailing, an attack, assault, ill-treatment, molestation (केश-प्˚, dragging by the hair), MBh.; R.
प्र-˚धर्षणीय mfn. to be assailed, assailable, open to attack, exposed to injury or ill-treatment, MBh.
प्र-˚धर्षित mfn. (fr. Caus.) attacked, hurt, injured, MBh.; R.; BhP.
haughty, arrogant, W.
प्र-˚धर्षित—वत् mfn. arrogant, proud, W.
प्र-˚धर्षिन् mfn. = ˚धर्षण mfn., Dharmaśarm.
प्र-˚धृष्ट mfn. treated with contumely, W.
proud, arrogant, ib.
प्र-˚धृष्टि f. overpowering, subjugation, ŚāṅkhŚr.
प्र-˚धृष्य mfn. to be hurt or injured, violable (see अ-प्˚, दुष्-प्˚, सु-प्˚).
प्र-√ धे Caus. -धापयति, to cause to suck, MānGṛ.
प्र-˚ध्मा mfn. blowing violently, MW.
प्र-˚ध्मापन n. (fr. Caus.) a remedy for difficult respiration (in med.), Suśr.
प्र-˚ध्मापित mfn. blown into, blown (as a conch shell), MBh.
प्र-˚ध्यान n. meditating upon, reflection, thinking, deep thought, subtle speculation, MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Car.
प्र-√ ध्रज् P. -ध्रजति, to run forward, RV. i, 166, 4.
प्र-˚ध्वंस m. utter destruction, annihilation, perishing, disappearance, Var.; Bhartṛ.
= ˚ध्वंसाभाव (below), Sarvad.
प्र-˚ध्वंस—त्व n. state of destruction, desolation, ruin, KapS., Sch.
प्र-˚ध्वंसाभाव m. nonexistence in consequence of annihilation, ceasing to exist, Tarkas.; Sarvad. &c.
प्र-˚ध्वं॑सन mfn. destroying, annihilating, MBh.
प्र-˚ध्वं॑सन m. one who destroys, a destroyer (as a partic. personification), ŚBr. (cf. प्राध्वंसन).
प्रा—ध्वं॑सन m. patr. fr. प्र-ध्वं॑सन, ŚBr.
प्र-˚ध्वंसित mfn. (fr. Caus.) destroyed, annihilated, dispelled, MW.
प्र-˚ध्वंसिन् mfn. passing away, transitory, perishable (उत्पन्न-प्˚, arisen and passing away again i.e. having no further consequences, TPrāt. Comm.), MBh.
(ifc.) destroying, annihilating, R.
प्र-˚ध्वस्त mfn. destroyed, perished, disappeared, MBh.; R.; Bhartṛ.; BhP.

प्र-√ ध्वन् P. -ध्वनति, to sound, resound, Śiś. :
Caus. -ध्वनयति, to cause to sound, Car.
प्र-˚ध्वान m. a loud sound, Dharmaśarm.
प्राध्वन॑ n. the bed of a river or stream, RV.
प्रा—धनिक n. (fr. -धन) an implement of war, weapon, BhP.
प्रा—धानिक mfn. (fr. -धान) pre-eminent, distinguished, superior, BhP.
(in Sāṃkhya) derived from or relating to Pradhāna or primary matter, MBh.; BhP.
प्रा—धान्येन ind. in regard to the highest object or chief matter, chiefly, mainly, summarily, Nir.; MBh.; Hariv. &c.
प्रा—धान्यात् ind. in regard to the highest object or chief matter, chiefly, mainly, summarily, Nir.; MBh.; Hariv. &c.
प्रा—धान्य—तस् ind. in regard to the highest object or chief matter, chiefly, mainly, summarily, Nir.; MBh.; Hariv. &c.
प्रा—धान्य—स्तुति mfn., chiefly praised
प्रा—धेय mfn. descended from Prādhā, MBh. (cf. कर्ण-प्राधेय).
प्राधीत mfn. one who has begun his studies, R.
advanced in study, well-read, learned (said of Brāhmans), Gaut.
प्राध्ययन n. commencement of recitation or study, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
प्राध्य्-एषण n. (fr. प्र-अधि- √ 1. इष्) incitement, exhortation (to study), ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Kathās.
प्राध्व mfn. (fr. प्र + अध्वन्; but accord. to some fr. प्र and √ ध्वृ = ह्वृ) being on a journey, Pāṇ. v, 4, 85
inclined, L.
humble, L.
distant, long, W.
प्राध्व m. start, precedence, first place (˚ध्वे-√ कृ, with acc. and gen. ‘to place a person at the head of’), Kāṭh.
a long way or journey, L.
a bond, tie, L.
a joke, sport, L.
प्राध्वम् ind. far away (with √ कृ, ‘to put aside’), MBh.
after the precedent of (gen.), Āpast.
favourably, kindly, Ragh.
humbly, Hcar.
conformably, L.
प्राध्वर mf(ई)n. (only ˚री-शाखा?), Cat.
